learning_outcomes.text: Explains the classification, chemical structures, and basic physical, mechanical, and thermal properties of plastic materials.
Compares the properties of thermoplastics, thermosets, and engineering plastics, and selects appropriate materials for different engineering applications.
Explains the operating principles and application areas of plastic production methods such as injection molding, extrusion, blow molding, and rotational molding.
Interprets fundamental physical, mechanical, and thermal test methods used in the characterization of plastic materials and evaluates the results obtained.
Gains knowledge about plastic recycling, bioplastics, and sustainable plastic technologies, and evaluates environmental impacts from an engineering perspective.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to plastic materials, history and classification
Chemical structure and molecular properties of polymers
Thermoplastics: Structures, properties and application areas
Thermosets and elastomers: Structures and applications
Plastic additives: Stabilizers, fillers, colorants and plasticizers
Plastic production methods I: Injection molding and extrusion
Plastic production methods II: Blow molding, thermoforming and 3D printing technologies
Plastic production methods III: Extrusion technology
Plastic production methods IV: Rotational molding technology
Physical, mechanical and thermal properties of plastics and characterization methods
Composite polymers, bioplastics and sustainable plastic technologies
Plastic recycling, environmental impacts and circular economy
Plastic applications in automotive, medical, packaging, construction and energy sectors
